title: AgentShield policy exceptions gated on SARIF evidence
objective: Require AgentShield SARIF or report evidence, policy-pack source, owner/ticket/scope/expiry fields, and expired-exception enforcement before promoting a policy exception.
source_rule: No exception without evidence: SARIF/report first, owner and expiry always.
allowed_evidence: AgentShield SARIF output or JSON report for the finding
owner, ticket, scope, and expiry for the exception
forbidden_actions: approving policy exceptions without SARIF or report evidence
blanket-suppressing AgentShield policy packs or organization-policy gates
editing AgentShield code or policy files from this ECC evaluator run
acceptance_gates: SARIF or report evidence is named
owner, ticket, scope, and expiry state are recorded
expired exceptions stay rejected or enforced
remediation versus time-boxed exception decision is explicit
